violated_contract: A 5xx regression concentrated on one backend route must page even when the service-wide 5xx ratio stays flat. Cloud Run's platform request metrics carry no route label, so a route-level failure — including platform-generated 504s that never produce an application ERROR log — hides inside the service aggregate until a user-facing symptom surfaces elsewhere.
canonical_prevention: Provision a Cloud Logging counter over backend request logs that labels each 5xx series with a bounded route tuple — method plus a finite static route catalogue, with parameterised segments collapsed — and alert on a sustained per-route count above a threshold chosen from measured incident and chronic rates, so chronic background errors do not page continuously. Provision it from the deploy path so the failure cannot block a deploy that would otherwise succeed, while still surfacing the failure in the run.
